title: 凌晨五点
setting: A hotel in Xi'an, 5:00 am. You checked in at two and can't remember your room number.

silence.en: Hello? Hello? Can you hear me?

silence.zh: 您好？您是不是又睡着了？
silence.en: Hello? Have you fallen asleep again?

hangup.zh: 那我十分钟以后再给您打。
hangup.en: I'll try you again in ten minutes, then.
She hung up. At 5:10 the phone rings again.

steps.zh: 您好，早上好！这里是前台。
steps.en: Hello, good morning! This is the front desk.

steps.zh: 现在是早上五点整，这是您的叫醒服务。
steps.en: It's exactly five o'clock. This is your wake-up call.

say.en: It's five in the morning. Tell her you never asked for a wake-up call.
say.cue: You never booked a wake-up call.
answers: 什么？我没让你们叫我啊。
say.gloss: Huh? I never booked a wake-up call.
say.tip: 没订 = didn't book. 没 + verb says it never happened: 我没订 = I never booked it.

mistakes.note: 不订 means you won't book it. For something that never happened, use 没: 我没订.
That says you don't want one now. She thinks you booked it: tell her 我没订 (I never booked it).

ok.zh: 是吗？请问是八零八房间吗？
ok.en: Really? This is room 808, isn't it?

say.en: She's asking if you're in room 808. You can't remember: ask her to hold on while you check.
say.gloss: Hold on a moment, let me check.
say.tip: 稍等一下 = hold on a moment (稍 = slightly): the polite way to put someone on pause. 房卡 = key card.

steps.narr: You fumble for the key card on the bedside table. It says 806.

say.en: Your key card says 806. Tell her you're in 806, not 808.
answers: 我是八零六的，不是八零八。

not.note: That says you're NOT in 806. Tell her: 我是八零六。

say.tip: Room numbers are read digit by digit: 八零六 bā líng liù. 您打错了 = you've got the wrong number.

mistakes.note: Room numbers go digit by digit: 八零六 (eight, zero, six), not 八百零六 (eight hundred and six).

ok.en: Oh dear, I'm so sorry, wrong room!

fail.en: Which room are you in, then?

steps.zh: 今天早餐打八折，要不要给您来一份？
steps.en: Breakfast is twenty percent off today. Shall I put you down for one?

say.en: She's selling you breakfast, at five in the morning. Say no thanks.
answers: 不用不用，我想再睡会儿。
say.tip: 不用了，谢谢 = no, thank you: the polite no to any sales pitch. 打八折 = you pay eight tenths, so 20% off.

silence.zh: 您不说话，我就当您同意了啊？
silence.en: If you don't say anything, I'll take that as a yes?
Hello? I'll go ahead and order it, then?

hangup.zh: 好的！早餐五点半送到您房间！
hangup.en: Lovely! Breakfast will be at your door at half past five!
Silence means yes, apparently. Breakfast arrives at 5:30.

alts.gloss: Oh, go on then, I'll have one.

then.zh: 好嘞！五点半给您送到房间！
then.en: Great! It'll be at your door at half past five!
Breakfast arrives at 5:30. You eat roujiamo in the dark, wide awake. Room 808 sleeps on.
then.zh: 五点半，早餐到了。你彻底醒了。

ok.zh: 别呀，我们有小笼包、豆浆、油条，还有肉夹馍！
ok.en: Oh, don't say that! We've got xiaolongbao, soy milk, youtiao, and roujiamo!

fail.en: So I'll book you in, shall I?

say.en: Tell her you're going back to sleep, and that's that.
answers: 我要再睡会儿，先这样吧。
真不用了，我睡了，就这样吧。
不用了，我再睡会儿，拜拜。
say.gloss: I'm going back to sleep. Let's leave it there.

not.note: That says you DON'T want more sleep. You do: 我要再睡会儿。

say.tip: 先这样吧 = let's leave it there for now: the soft way to end a call. 再睡会儿 = sleep a bit longer.

ok.en: Of course! I'll let you get some rest!

ok.zh: 那六点我再打给您，提醒您吃早餐！
ok.en: I'll call you again at six, then, to remind you about breakfast!

fail.zh: 您说什么？是要订早餐吗？
fail.en: Sorry? Was that a yes to breakfast?

0.tip: 我要睡了 = I'm off to sleep: 要……了 = about to.

steps.en: You win. Until six o'clock sharp, when the phone rings again.
